## Goal
Describe the change in one or two sentences.

## Requirements
- Keep the existing game structure unless the task requires otherwise.
- Preserve save data, permanent level IDs, and expansion IDs.
- Test the affected controls, levels, and menus.
- Do not add unrelated features.

## Done when
- The requested behavior works.
- Existing gameplay still works.
- Changes are committed on a separate branch.
- A pull request is opened with a short summary and test notes.
